ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 55% high-intensity white pixels on distal lobes and 45% low-intensity black pixels concentrated centrally and along trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white fields occupy the outer halves of both lobes. Dense low-intensity black mottling and stippling radiate from the central peduncle area. A distinct, isolated horizontal black arc is visible on the distal high-intensity field of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior angle estimated at 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. A prominent macro-scale avulsion/notch is visible at the terminal tip of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature tapering to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered high-contrast dark circular pixel clusters visible on the white regions of both lobes, particularly on the lower-right distal surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, roughly parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented horizontally on the white pigmentation field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss (notch) on the left lobe tip and irregular, jagged scarring across the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, dark horizontal linear feature located within the white field of the right fluke lobe, distinct from surrounding mottling.
